Privacy

Privacy, in plain English.

This page describes what actually happens on this website — not a generic template. If you would like anything explained differently, ask us.

Note for the site owner

The business details used on this page are still template values from src/config/site.ts. Before launch, replace them and have this page reviewed against your actual business practices and legal obligations in your jurisdiction. This notice disappears once the placeholder details are updated.

The short version

  • No accounts, no logins, no advertising, no analytics and no tracking pixels.
  • This site does not set cookies for tracking. Your estimator inputs are calculated in your browser.
  • An enquiry reaches us only when you choose to send it — and exactly how that works is described below.

What this site collects

Nothing, until you act. You can browse every page, run the savings estimator and read the knowledge hub without providing any personal information.

Two things are worth describing precisely:

The savings estimator

All estimator calculations run entirely in your browser. If you choose to carry your estimate across to the enquiry form, a small summary of your inputs and the modelled result is saved in your browser's session storage (under the key solvanta-estimate-prefill). It never leaves your device unless you send the enquiry, and it is cleared when the form reads it or when your browser session ends.

The enquiry form

The form asks for the details needed to respond usefully: your name, a way to reach you, your postcode or region, property notes, and a message. Only the fields marked required are required.

This site does not transmit form contents to any server, and no public email address is configured. Submitting the form offers you the details to copy, so nothing leaves your browser unless you choose to share it by another means.

How enquiry information is used

  • To respond to your enquiry and, if it progresses, to prepare an assessment or proposal.
  • For the ordinary record-keeping any business keeps about its enquiries and jobs — we do not sell or rent personal information, and we do not use it for advertising.
  • We do not add people who enquire to marketing lists without their agreement.

Third-party requests this site makes

Good privacy pages are specific. When you load a page, your browser makes these external requests:

  • Google Fonts — the typefaces are loaded from Google's font service, which means your IP address and basic request data are visible to Google as the fonts download. If you prefer to avoid that, the site owner can self-host the font files; otherwise you can block the request, and the site falls back to system fonts.
  • Hosting — the pages themselves are served by a hosting provider, which may keep standard server logs (including IP addresses) for security and operational purposes. We do not run analytics on top of those logs.

There are no embedded social widgets, chat widgets, session-recording scripts or advertising networks on this site. Links to other websites (for example, government rebate pages) are governed by those websites' own privacy policies.

Access, correction and questions

You can ask what information we hold about you, ask for it to be corrected, or ask for it to be deleted where there is no legal reason for us to keep it. Use the contact page to start that conversation.

If you are not satisfied with how a privacy question is handled, you can contact the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (oaic.gov.au), which also publishes broader guidance on privacy rights in Australia.

Changes to this page

If this site's data practices change (for example, if an enquiry service or analytics tool is added), this page will be updated and the date at the top changed before or at the same time as the change takes effect.
